ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast ratio (~70:30 white-to-black pixel distribution) with dominant high-intensity pixels on mid-lobes and low-intensity pixels concentrated at the trailing edges, tips, and median notch region.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large white contiguous regions on the interior of both lobes. Dark pixel clusters (black) are mapped along the entire trailing edge and tips. A vertical dark pixel streak is located on the mid-inner portion of the right lobe. Diffuse dark mottling is present in the lower central region near the notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped median notch with an estimated internal angle of approximately 45-50 degrees; apex depth extends significantly into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations present along the full trailing edge. Discrete peaks and valleys are irregular, with several deep indentations/notches on the inner trailing edge of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the leading edges; the trailing edge exhibits a complex curve with concavity near the notch transitioning to convexity towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Visible high-contrast dark clusters at the distal tips of both lobes, consistent with localized barnacle colonization patterns. Small dark focal spots are scattered on the inner left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One distinct vertical dark linear disruption on the mid-right lobe. Faint diagonal linear markings visible on the upper left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular notches and missing segments along the trailing edge topography, particularly on the inner lobes, indicating physical trauma or wear.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique combination of jagged serration and specific dark focal point distribution on the right lobe's white surface.
